_about: Hook formulas taken from a 'Top 10 Hooks for Creators' reel (9 formulas shown on screen + 'Hook #10 ???'), turned into Hinglish with one example per service. Every hook is an OPEN LOOP: it ends on '...' and the next beat must answer it. Used by src/hooks.py; edit freely.

formulas.hinglish: Bohot kam log ye kar rahe hain

examples.website: Bohot kam dukaan wale ye ek cheez apni website par rakhte hain…
examples.chatbot: Bohot kam business raat ke messages ka ye jawab dete hain…
examples.animated_ads: Bohot kam brands apne ads mein ye ek cheez karte hain…
examples.lead_gen: Bohot kam log enquiry aane ke baad ye karte hain…
examples.reel_scripts: Bohot kam creators reel likhne se pehle ye karte hain…
examples.seo_blogs: Bohot kam dukaan wale Google ke liye ye likhte hain…

formulas.english: I wish I knew this earlier…
formulas.hinglish: Kaash mujhe ye pehle pata hota
formulas.kind: hindsight: a lesson, then the lesson is the body

examples.website: Kaash mujhe apni dukaan ki website ke baare mein ye pehle pata hota…
examples.chatbot: Kaash maine raat ke messages ke liye ye pehle laga liya hota…
examples.animated_ads: Kaash mujhe ads ke baare mein ye pehle pata hota…
examples.lead_gen: Kaash mujhe enquiry sambhalne ka ye tareeka pehle pata hota…
examples.reel_scripts: Kaash mujhe reel likhne ka ye tareeka pehle pata hota…
examples.seo_blogs: Kaash maine Google ke liye blog pehle aise likha hota…

formulas.kind: observation: something the viewer has seen but never named

examples.website: Kabhi dhyan diya hai, log website dekhkar pehle kya judge karte hain…
examples.chatbot: Kabhi dhyan diya hai, raat ko aaye messages ka kya hota hai…
examples.animated_ads: Kabhi dhyan diya hai, ads mein log pehle kya dekhte hain…
examples.lead_gen: Kabhi dhyan diya hai, enquiry aate hi log kyun gayab ho jaate hain…
examples.reel_scripts: Kabhi dhyan diya hai, kuch reels pehle second mein hi rok leti hain…
examples.seo_blogs: Kabhi dhyan diya hai, Google par pehla result kaisa hota hai…

formulas.hinglish: Main iske baare mein galat tha
formulas.kind: confession: admits a mistake, the correction is the payoff

examples.website: Main website ke baare mein ek cheez mein bilkul galat tha…
examples.chatbot: Main chatbot ke baare mein ek baat mein galat tha…
examples.animated_ads: Main animated ads ke baare mein galat soch raha tha…
examples.lead_gen: Main leads ke baare mein ek cheez mein galat tha…
examples.reel_scripts: Main reel scripts ke baare mein ek baat mein galat tha…
examples.seo_blogs: Main blogs ke baare mein ek baat mein galat tha…

formulas.kind: reveal: the unspoken truth about the topic

examples.website: Dukaan ki website ki asli sachchai ye hai…
examples.chatbot: Chatbot ki asli sachchai ye hai…
examples.animated_ads: Animated ads ki asli sachchai ye hai…
examples.lead_gen: Leads ki asli sachchai ye hai…
examples.reel_scripts: Reels ki asli sachchai ye hai…
examples.seo_blogs: Blogs ki asli sachchai ye hai…

formulas.kind: command: names a habit to drop

examples.website: Website par ye ek cheez karna band karo…
examples.chatbot: Raat ke messages ko ignore karna band karo…
examples.animated_ads: Ads mein ye ek galti karna band karo…
examples.lead_gen: Enquiry ka jawab der se dena band karo…
examples.reel_scripts: Reels ka pehla second waste karna band karo…
examples.seo_blogs: Blog mein ye ek galti karna band karo…

formulas.english: You may not agree with this…
formulas.kind: contrarian: a take that makes people argue or save

examples.website: Shayad aap agree na karo, par dukaan ko website chahiye…
examples.chatbot: Shayad aap agree na karo, par chatbot raat ka staff ban sakta hai…
examples.animated_ads: Shayad aap agree na karo, par ads ko animation chahiye…
examples.lead_gen: Shayad aap agree na karo, par har enquiry ek lead nahi hoti…
examples.reel_scripts: Shayad aap agree na karo, par reel ka script pehle likhna chahiye…
examples.seo_blogs: Shayad aap agree na karo, par blog Google ke liye likhna chahiye…

formulas.hinglish: Ye aapko hairan kar sakta hai
formulas.kind: surprise: a fact that breaks an assumption

examples.website: Ye aapko hairan kar sakta hai: log website pe kitni der rukte hain…
examples.chatbot: Ye aapko hairan kar sakta hai: chatbot kitne kaam kar leta hai…
examples.animated_ads: Ye aapko hairan kar sakta hai: ad ke pehle teen second ka kaam…
examples.lead_gen: Ye aapko hairan kar sakta hai: leads kahan kho jaati hain…
examples.reel_scripts: Ye aapko hairan kar sakta hai: reel kahan se skip hoti hai…
examples.seo_blogs: Ye aapko hairan kar sakta hai: log Google par kya search karte hain…

formulas.english: X is the reason why you are Y…
formulas.hinglish: X hi wajah hai ki aap Y
formulas.kind: cause: names the hidden cause of a loss the viewer feels

examples.website: Website na hona hi wajah hai ki customers aapko dhundh nahi paate…
examples.chatbot: Der se reply hi wajah hai ki customers kahin aur chale jaate hain…
examples.animated_ads: Plain ads hi wajah hain ki log scroll karke aage badh jaate hain…
examples.lead_gen: Follow-up ki kami hi wajah hai ki leads thandi pad jaati hain…
examples.reel_scripts: Kamzor pehli line hi wajah hai ki reel chal nahi paati…
examples.seo_blogs: Galat keywords hi wajah hain ki blog Google par nahi dikhta…
